entities.summary: Onyang Bang clan is a Korean clan. Their Bon-gwan is in Asan, South Chungcheong Province. As of 2015, there are about 80445 members of this clan. Their founder was Bang Ji, who brought Confucian texts in Silla as the Tang alliance's envoy in 669. After that, he settled in Sangju.
